notes: «قال حدثني أبي» is a bare relation with no name, so «أبي» is a relation link
«أبي الحسن (١)» : the «(١)» is a footnote mark and is not part of the surface
«قال: قال أبو جعفر عليه السلام» names the Imam in the words after the chain: he is the last link (owner ruling 2)
«رضي الله عنه» is a blessing and is left out
